text:
Task landed. Summary:

1. **`public/framework/core/Page/card/inventory.json`** (worktree) — 9 distinct card kinds found by grepping `background` across `public/framework`, `public/imagine`, `public/layouts`, most-used first (page preview 71 uses, `.card`/`.surface` 59, chip/pill 37, chat bubble 13, icon card 8, AI2 rail row 6, decision box 3, accordion row 2, object card 2), each with its file:line, use count, and visual details.
2. **8 screenshots** at 1920, cropped to the real card, in `public/framework/core/Page/card/inventory/*.png` — took real debugging to get right: `page-preview` elements exist twice on every page (a hidden global search index at 0×0, plus the real visible wall), so the first script's naive selector kept hitting the invisible copy.
3. **`public/framework/ai/2026-09-29/cards-and-logs/inventory/findings.md`** (11 lines) — 5 different background tokens doing the same job, padding hand-written 4 different ways instead of one shared token, nesting almost always one level deep, and the worst split: `.card` and `page-preview` use two unrelated visual languages (border stripe vs. shadow+ring) for "this is a card."

No CSS/JS touched, no page.js created, per the brief. Everything logged in the task's `task.jsonl`.

Done. Summary:

- Built `public/framework/core/Page/card/log/Logger.js` — `Logger.attach(obj)` gives any object `this.log(...)`; `Logger.wrap(obj, ["method"])` makes each call (sync or async) its own nested group; three opt-in outputs (`Console`, `Memory`, `JSONL`) plus `Logger.from_jsonl(text)` to read a saved log back.
- Built `LogView.js` — renders the log live as nested cards: level 1-2 boxed (`.card`), level 3+ a plain heading at the same indentation, exactly per the owner's "a H2 doesn't need extra indentation" example — proven in a screenshot, not just described.
- Built `page.js` (title "Log") with three live demos — a clickable Counter, a four-level depth demo, and a JSONL round-trip — plus `readme.md` and `doc/logger.md`.
- Verified headless (Playwright, windowsHide): **zero console errors**; screenshots at 1920 and 400 saved in the task dir (`screenshot-1920.png`, `screenshot-400.png`). Added the minimal `card/page.js` stub the brief anticipated, so the page routes.
- Committed in the worktree (8 files, fence-only — left ~225 unrelated `files.jsonl`/`page.jsonl` noise from the live crawl untouched). Landed in the logger task's own `task.jsonl`; flagged two things for the parent: register the `log-` CSS prefix in `styles/css-scopes.txt`, and replace the `card/page.js` stub with the real card-system index.

Done. Summary:

- Fixed the three issues in the log you built: log lines now sit tight (0.2em) while groups keep the full gap, the group toggle is a plain heading with a rotating caret and "N lines · X ms" (`Logger.js` now tracks each group's `duration`), and `log-` is registered in `styles/css-scopes.txt`.
- Built `whisper/ClipMic.js` — plays a saved WAV through `MicStream`'s real worklet pipeline (stands in for `getUserMedia` for one call, never edits `audio/**`) — and `whisper/Instrument.js`, which wraps `tick`/`transcribe`/`commit_all` as Logger groups and hooks `on_final` from outside, so skipped ticks are one muted line and a forced commit reads as a seam.
- Built the debug page itself (`whisper/page.js`, `Transcript.js`): pick a clip or use the mic, watch each tick's audio length, raw whisper text, agreement, and highlighted commit live; a running transcript with clickable seams; Download/Load JSONL to keep and compare runs; a one-sentence message if whisper-server isn't answering.
- Proved it headless against the real JFK clip: **zero console errors**, ≥5 real transcribed ticks visible at both 1920 and 400 (screenshots in the task dir) — the log genuinely shows "And so, my fellow Americans, ask not..." coming back from whisper-server.
- Committed in the worktree (15 files, fence-only — left `card/page.js` alone for minion-card-system). Landed in `whisper/task.jsonl` with links to the live page and docs; two caveats named in `whisper/readme.md`'s Watch out (server-down path untested live; `commit_all`'s seam label also covers `stop()`'s own flush).

The card system is built, documented, and committed. Summary:

**Built `core/Page/card/`** — the site's card design system, with six live demo children: **Grounds** (four backgrounds — default, light gray, dark, strong hue — reusing `tone.js`'s always-dark-island trick), **Nesting** (levels 1–3 boxed, 4+ drops to a plain heading, readable at 400px), **Headers & menus** (all six patterns: none, heading, icon+title, header-bar-with-⋯-menu, clickable, expandable), **Mini pages** (the owner's decision proven live: a card's data is one `page.jsonl` line, routed through a custom `route()`, reload lands on the same card, zero folders), and **Scale** (small/default/large via the existing `.size-*` classes). `card/log/` (the sibling minion's) is now a real child, unchanged.

**Proof**: 9 pages × 2 widths screenshotted headless (`ai/2026-09-29/cards-and-logs/system/shots/`), zero console errors, zero failed requests on every one — caught and fixed one real bug in review (clickable cards inherited blue underlined link styling). New CSS is 73 lines, all under a `card-` prefix reserved in `css-scopes.txt`. Committed 17 files by exact path in `worktree/cards-and-logs` (`1e38a97f`) — nothing outside my fence touched.

**Left for the parent task**: `card/log/readme.md` (outside my fence) still calls `card/page.js` "a stub" — now stale, flagged in `task.jsonl` for whoever merges. Full walkthrough/`review.mjs` pass left to `task-mastermind-cards-and-logs`, which owns landing both halves together.

**Summary:** Wired `card` into `core/Page/page.js`'s children and added the readme line; rebuilt [`core/Page/card/`](http://localhost:52442/framework/core/Page/card/) to show, not tell — a live sample (one card per ground, three deep, header bar + a real ⋯ button), the six sub-topics as the site's own preview wall, and a two-sentence paragraph, all at full 1920 width. Found and fixed a real bug along the way: `MiniPages`'s own `card` verb was shadowing Page's `card` property and crashing the new preview wall. Added the two missed inventory rows (ext/Panel, the switcher) the mid-turn ask named. Headless-verified all three named pages load with zero console errors and zero failed requests, screenshots saved beside the task log. A fresh-eyes review ran (`review.mjs`): 4 findings fixed, 3 declined with reasons, 1 noted — all answered and landed in `task.jsonl`. Everything committed in worktree `cards-and-logs` (commits `fdb587f1`, `0b290d3d`); the many unrelated `files.jsonl`/`page.jsonl`/`board.jsonl` churn was left untouched as instructed.

**Fixed:** `.card-dark`/`.card-prim` now set their own `color: var(--ink)` (at sufficient specificity to beat `a.card`'s `color: inherit`) so the mini-pages "Going deep" card is readable — confirmed headless at 1920 with zero console errors, screenshot saved; `headers/page.js`'s ⋯ menus are real `<button>`s now; and the two doc moves (system.md decision to the top, whisper readme's Watch out trimmed with a link to doc/clipmic.md) are done — all committed by exact path (`01901524`).
